qualification: Observed failures only; diagnosis is unverified. Not approved repair guidance.

review.explanation: No guidance was delivered for this attempt. Its patch preserved listener ordering and reentrant cleanup but left decode settlement publishing directly; the scored corrective repair instead gated publication after retirement. That comparison is recurring evidence of a patch mismatch, not a verified cause.
review.next_check: Start a delayed decode, close the panel before it settles, then resolve it; expect zero publication after close and zero active listeners.

review.explanation: No guidance was delivered for this attempt. The patch made cleanup reentry-safe but did not condition a previously started decode on its originating visit; the scored repair did. The observation does not isolate that difference as the cause.
review.next_check: Start a delayed decode for one selection, synchronously switch selections, then settle both; expect no first-selection publication and bootstrap plus update for the selected one.

review.explanation: No guidance was delivered for this attempt. The patch did not distinguish settlement belonging to a retired visit from settlement for a reopened visit using the same channel. The scored repair passed with a publication gate, but causation remains unverified.
review.next_check: Start a delayed decode, close, reopen the same channel, and settle the old decode; expect no old-visit publication while the reopened visit receives bootstrap and its later update.

review.explanation: No guidance was delivered for this attempt. As in the recurring earlier failure, the patch guarded cleanup reassignment but allowed decoded settlement to publish without checking whether its visit remained active. The passing repair comparison does not verify cause.
review.next_check: Delay a decode from the first selection, synchronously select another, then settle the delayed decode; expect no old-selection publication and continued publication for the active selection.

review.explanation: No guidance was delivered for this attempt. Listener removal is documented to detach reception while an already-started decode can settle; the patch did not separately constrain that settlement. The passing repair is not proof of the failure’s cause.
review.next_check: Begin a delayed decode, hide the panel before settlement, and resolve it; expect no publication after hide and zero active listeners.

review.explanation: No guidance was delivered for this attempt. The recurring patch mismatch was absence of visit-bound publication for a decode started before retirement; the corrective repair passed after adding such a gate, without independently establishing causation.
review.next_check: Retire a visit, reopen the same channel, then resolve a decode started by the retired visit; expect only the reopened visit’s bootstrap and later update to publish.
